rule: Canonical identity is username plus live BUSINESS/CREATOR provider readback. Discover both id and user_id with INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO(me); id is the provider connection node identity and user_id is the Instagram Graph publication identity. Observed numeric IDs are evidence only and must not be compile-time publication authority.
publish_binding: Use the same selected canonical connection for identity check, create, publish and readback; use the live user_id returned by the verified connection as publication identity.
